_comment: Hand-owned. Hills that have opened this season and shut again. closed is the first day shut; a future date shows the hill open through the day before, then paused. The first lift stays in the record as it happened; this only stops the site calling the hill open. reopens, when the hill has posted it, is the first day back; the hill reads open again from then. Without it, delete the entry when the hill reopens.

andes-tower-hills.note: Supplied by David on 15 November 2026: Andes Tower Hills closed again, two days after opening. Andes Tower Hills homepage, seen 22 November 2026: "Upcoming Hours Thanksgiving Weekend Friday-Sunday Nov. 27-29th 10am-5pm".

wild-mountain.note: Instagram, seen 20 November 2026, supplied by David: open 4-8pm Friday 20 November; closed Saturday 21 to Tuesday 24 November for snowmaking; back Wednesday 25 November 1-8pm; closed Thanksgiving; Friday 27 November terrain and hours TBD.
